title: Call for Proceedings - ISMB/ECCB 2027
institution: International Society for Computational Biology (ISCB), ISMB/ECCB 2027
about: ISMB/ECCB 2027, held in Copenhagen on 18-22 July 2027, invites proceedings papers in computational biology. Accepted papers appear in an open-access section of the journal Bioinformatics. Submissions close on 14 January 2027, 11:59 PM Anywhere on Earth, with no extensions.
requirements: Papers submitted electronically as PDF via the submission system
Code used in papers must be in a publicly accessible repository, complete enough for review by the deadline

upskill.name: AI Foundations Academy
why: field "Computational biology and bioinformatics" → "Healthcare: diagnostic imaging, drug discovery, genomics, clinical decision support" (A001.21, Domain Applications of AI I)
"invites proceedings papers in computational biology" → "Scientific discovery: protein folding (AlphaFold), materials science, climate modelling" (A001.21)
Shortlisted courses scoring at least 6 matched only generic terms ("call", "code", "system"), so the Academy page is used instead of a specific course
